site.title: Zero-Cost AI Coding
site.tagline: Real tools. Genuinely free. No card, no trial.
site.audience: Developers and indie builders who want real tools at genuine $0 cost — no card, no trial-that-converts
site.description: Single-file, working web tools that solve real developer problems using genuinely free AI, compute, and hosting — every free-tier claim verified against the provider's own current docs.

articles.title: Error Triage
articles.hook: Paste an error, stack trace, or log dump — get classification, root cause, concrete fix steps, and pitfalls, using Groq's free LLM API.
articles.how_free: Groq free tier: 30 req/min, 14,400 req/day, no card — verified at console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits

articles.title: SQL Schema to TypeScript & Migration Generator
articles.hook: Convert PostgreSQL DDL schemas into clean TypeScript interfaces and rollback SQL completely client-side.
articles.how_free: Unlimited client-side execution using standard Browser Web APIs.

articles.title: Commit Forge
articles.hook: Generate conventional commit messages from your git diff using Google Gemini's free API — 1,500 requests/day, no card needed.
articles.how_free: Google Gemini 2.0 Flash free tier: 15 RPM, 1,500 RPD, no credit card — verified at ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/rate-limits

articles.title: Alt Text Generator
articles.hook: Generate image alt text with an AI model that runs entirely in your browser — no API key, no server, no limit.
articles.how_free: No tier to exceed — Xenova/vit-gpt2-image-captioning runs client-side via Transformers.js/ONNX Runtime Web; only cost is a one-time ~240MB model download cached by the browser.

articles.title: Stack Trace Autopsy
articles.hook: Paste a production stack trace and get the error, the exact user-code line that failed, and ready-to-click Google/Stack Overflow search links — 100% client-side, no API, no limit.
articles.how_free: ∞ runs — pure client-side regex/string parsing in the browser tab, no external service, no key, no rate limit.

articles.title: Regex Forge
articles.hook: Describe what you want to match in plain English, get a working regex with explanation and a live tester — 1,500 requests/day on Gemini free tier, no card needed.
articles.how_free: Google Gemini 2.0 Flash free tier: 15 RPM, 1,500 RPD, no credit card — verified at ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/rate-limits

articles.title: Dead Export Finder
articles.hook: Drop a repo folder in your browser and get every unused export and unreachable file in it — full import graph, client-side, no upload and no quota.
articles.how_free: Runs entirely client-side so there is no API or quota; hosting is GitHub Pages, soft 100 GB/month bandwidth and 1 GB site size, verified against GitHub's own limits doc.

articles.title: JWT Crack
articles.hook: Paste any JWT and instantly see decoded header, payload, and security analysis — expiration, algorithm warnings, claim breakdown. 100% browser-native, zero network calls.
articles.how_free: No service needed — runs entirely in-browser via base64url decoding and JSON parsing. Zero cost, zero limits, zero API calls.

articles.title: Actions Forge
articles.hook: Configure a GitHub Actions CI workflow for your stack — pick steps, get a complete ci.yml with proper caching, current action versions, and job ordering. Free for public repos.
articles.how_free: GitHub Actions: unlimited minutes for public repos, 2,000 min/month for private repos on free tier — no card needed. Verified at docs.github.com/en/billing/managing-billing-for-github-actions

articles.title: Cron Expression Builder
articles.hook: Build a cron expression with live plain-English explanation and next-runs preview — works for crontab, GitHub Actions, Airflow, and anything that takes 5-field POSIX cron.
articles.how_free: ∞ runs — pure client-side parsing and next-run calculation in the browser tab, no external service, no key, no rate limit.

articles.title: Browser-Native Regex & Stream Extractor
articles.hook: Extract structured JSON, clean sensitive logs, or test complex regex directly in your browser with 100% zero network overhead and unlimited free local compute.
articles.how_free: 100% Client-Side Native JS Engine - Unlimited local processing

articles.title: Zero-Cost Favicon & PWA Generator
articles.hook: Generate all standard favicon and PWA icon sizes (including a real .ico) from one image, 100% client-side with no limits.
articles.how_free: 100% client-side using Canvas API and JSZip; no external API limits.

articles.title: Log Pattern Triage
articles.hook: Paste or open NDJSON and plain-text logs to group recurring messages, count levels, redact likely secrets, and export a triage report at $0 with no provider quota.
articles.how_free: Browser-local File API processing has no provider request quota; MDN publishes no hard file-size limit, so practical capacity is bounded by device memory.

articles.title: Curl-to-Code Converter
articles.hook: Paste a curl command and get idiomatic code in Python, JavaScript, Go, PHP, Rust, and Node — 100% client-side, no API, no limit.
articles.how_free: ∞ runs — pure client-side curl parsing and code generation in the browser tab, no external service, no key, no rate limit.

articles.title: Log & Trace Structurer

articles.how_free: Unlimited client-side execution using standard Browser Web APIs.

articles.title: SQL EXPLAIN & Query Optimizer
